caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a hand tool with a wooden handle and a metal blade. The handle is light brown, with visible darker brown lines resembling wood grain, and features a prominent curled end on the left side, a small upward-facing notch below it near the center, and a rounded protrusion near the right end. The handle has two visible screw or rivet heads illustrated as small circles. Attached to the upper edge of the handle is a short, rectangular, metallic-looking blade that is grayish in color with hints of rust or oxidation, and it has a row of evenly spaced, sharp triangular teeth along its top edge. The object is centered against a plain, off-white background with some light brownish stains and faint pencil marks around the edges.
title: Handmade Saw
